description: This file declares the MediaType class within the beerocks namespace, providing static methods to determine the media type of network interfaces and radio devices based on IEEE 802.11 revisions and other criteria.

classes.name: MediaType
classes.description: Provides static methods to determine media types for network components.

methods.name: get_802_11_media_type
methods.description: Retrieves the IEEE 802.11 media type supported by the given radio.

methods.name: get_media_type
methods.description: Determines the media type of a given network interface based on its name and media type group.
